paragraphs.text:
The sky darkens with building thunderheads. A roar splits the 
heavens, promising a heavy storm. You see a flash, and almost 
immediately, an almighty crack that jolts the eardrums. “Wow!” 
says Sylvia. “That must have hit somewhere nearby!”
It did. Smoke rises from the dry brush up the hill.

Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 402; if the result is odd, go 
to 403.
